name: Enable this tab manually · 35 meters · read only
info: Read-only Aurora AU-510M dashboard: all 35 requested meters, four sections on the existing /dashboard/au510m page (group ff_group_au510m_meter). Reuses radio 7fbf2bfc9badc7d3 and the existing Dashboard 2.0 group; does not define or modify configuration nodes. Enable this disabled tab and deploy it manually after importing. The local one-second clock requests meter list at startup, retries unavailable inventory after 15 seconds, and refreshes inventory every 60 seconds. Subscriptions resolve exact source/number/name identities to numeric meter IDs, avoiding MQTT wildcard ambiguity in +13.8A and AGC+. Only meter list and sub meter <numeric ID> are sent. No RF, audio, slice, transmit or other write commands. Subscription errors and missing meters appear on cards and in Debug. Waiting for data is not treated as a failed subscription. Samples older than 15 seconds are marked stale. All values originate in the installed flexradio-js scaling; no duplicate scaling. FWDPWR and REFPWR keep the raw dBm sample and convert Watts with 10 ** ((dBm - 30) / 10). Signal meter units come from radio metadata; missing units are explicitly labelled. PASTAT is raw with no undocumented bit decoding. Gauges are display scales only, with unclipped numbers and out-of-scale labels. Browser widgets have no outbound wires or radio controls. Live subscriptions have not been tested by Codex. Deploy helper remaps node IDs while preserving the external radio and Dashboard group IDs.
